programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: 魔法製造者~異世界魔法的製作方法~ #1
programme.desc: 下級貴族奧恩斯坦家的希恩是個內向的男孩,他在三歲時突然詢問父親這個世界有沒有魔法,在遭到否定後,他的情緒明顯變得消沉。姊姊瑪琳與青梅竹馬蘿絲商量鼓勵他的方法,卻目擊到湖上的奇異現象。自己轉生的世界沒有魔法?希恩將展開他的魔法開發奇幻物語。

programme.desc: 莉莉的素體「莉莉亞」突然來到學校上課。由於她說她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉來上課的,學校便特別允許了這件事。在課堂上不時找碴的莉莉亞讓阿久津越來越警戒。然而午休時,莉莉亞卻突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎維」突然出現在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那紳士風度般的態度當中所隱含的某種令人生畏的氣息給震撼,莉莉則是丟下他和扎維一同離去。阿久津很在意莉莉離去時那不自然的笑容,當他追上他們兩人時,他看到因為被扎維拿刀指著而嚇得渾身發抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #8
programme.desc: 燈悟在拉妮亞眼中看到了寂寞。她似乎悲觀地認為只剩打倒曾經很親近的阿西爾一途。然而燈悟卻認為羈絆正是要在彼此對立碰撞的情況下,才能變得比過去更加穩固。這番話的背後,似乎是源自他過去的經驗談?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因為被扎維給打傷而哭泣。目睹了這一幕的阿久津,其憤怒達到了巔峯,因而覺醒了惡魔之力。他以壓倒性的力量擊倒扎維,就在他準備給予其致命一擊的瞬間,莉莉擋在了他的面前。然而,阿久津卻因為憤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻擊莉莉……!?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #12

programme.title: 排球少年!! 第一季 #6
programme.desc: 在對上青葉城西高中時,影山碰到他之前的隊友,並遭受一陣嘲笑,於是他發誓要獲勝。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #5
programme.desc: 揚言要將防風鈴納為己有的獅子頭連頭領兔耳山丁子前來踢館,賭上兩方存亡的單挑對決即將揭開序幕。櫻一行人被帶入兔耳山等人的基地,一間通稱為「檻」的荒廢電影院。在被對手包圍下,有如置身牢籠之中,同樣以力量見長的杉下及有馬雪成的第一戰就此開始。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #6
programme.desc: 獅子頭連在團員敗北後直接開除的異樣光景,讓櫻等人感到動搖。但隨著難得顯露情緒的蘇枋獲勝,防風鈴正逐步邁向勝利。第三戰由防風鈴四天王的柊對上佐狐浩太,兩人之間似乎有著謎樣的過去。柊一開始面對敏捷的對手採取守勢,但也逐漸展現出武神應有的實力。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #4
programme.desc: 與風獄龍狄札斯特洛瓦的戰鬥揭開了序幕。儘管面對第三位階的強敵,在緋紅的精心策畫與指揮下,米海爾等人於戰鬥中逐漸取得優勢。目睹如此戰況的拉格納,再次體認緋紅對於實現自己的目的非常重要。另外在王都塞雷斯別拉,操控時間的翼之王出現在費姆德王面前。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #5
programme.desc: 收到上級龍接連斷絕音信的消息,讓正逐步準備消滅王國的翼之王奧偍瑪蒂亞開始警覺到有未知勢力的存在。而緋紅則是一邊預測翼之血族的動向,控制著戰況,一邊安排好讓拉格納和奧偍瑪蒂亞在王都展開對戰。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #5
programme.desc: 揚言要將防風鈴納為己有的獅子頭連頭領兔耳山丁子前來踢館,賭上兩方存亡的單挑對決即將揭開序幕。櫻一行人被帶入兔耳山等人的基地,一間通稱為「檻」的荒廢電影院。在被對手包圍下,有如置身牢籠之中,同樣以力量見長的杉下及有馬雪成的第一戰就此開始。

programme.desc: 獅子頭連在團員敗北後直接開除的異樣光景,讓櫻等人感到動搖。但隨著難得顯露情緒的蘇枋獲勝,防風鈴正逐步邁向勝利。第三戰由防風鈴四天王的柊對上佐狐浩太,兩人之間似乎有著謎樣的過去。柊一開始面對敏捷的對手採取守勢,但也逐漸展現出武神應有的實力。

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體侷限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑臺灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:「信」者無懼 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一羣捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-小先知書的大意義
programme.desc: #VALUE!

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體侷限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑臺灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:「信」者無懼 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂祕訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.desc: 究竟我們可以怎樣在生活和事奉裡討主的喜悅?論到《聖經》四福音書,記載了不少耳熟能詳關於耶穌的生平事蹟。程蒙恩長老提醒我們,可以從這些記載看到主耶穌喜歡什麼,我們學習喜歡主耶穌所歡喜的事物,就可以討主喜悅。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:三種人 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂祕訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由臺灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 劉三論今-風風雨雨牽手情
programme.desc: 聖經上說:「人的怒氣,並不成就神的義」,你怎麼靠著神,在處理夫妻之間的矛盾中經歷得勝?創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 靈修早晨

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#15粵
programme.desc: 妙喜喜歡以推理手法處事，廁所淤塞，妙喜決定追查到底，鎖定「兇手」是有朋、有義及高慶三人，妙喜發動「家中法庭」找「真兇」，意外發現「真兇」竟是妙喜本人，是她將所有「湯渣」倒進廁所內，才令鹹水渠淤塞。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#26粵普
programme.desc: 區夫人遊說二孃向十一娘求助，讓令宜上奏朝廷嚴查王煜之死，十一娘拒絕，二孃竟趁徐家舉辦花宴之時，披麻戴孝跪在徐家門前。令宜看在二孃份上本已打算幫忙，著十一娘暫避，但十一娘在令寬的幫忙下，成功平息風波。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 來到順德倫教，豈可錯過當地盛產的白糖糕！鼎爺試用石磨磨製米漿，與阿譚一探傳統手工「倫教糕」的做法。炒飯易學難精，要炒得粒粒分明兼「脆卜卜」，有何祕訣？鼎爺示範一道「鮮蝦黃金炒飯」，還提醒大家炒飯時「最緊要有耐性」！鮮淮山具豐富營養價值，既可煲湯亦能入饌，但日本淮山與中國淮山有甚麼分別？無米也可煮成「粥」！鼎爺巧妙利用參薯取代白米，配合鷓鴣、鮮淮山、圓肉和陳皮，煮出口感綿滑又健康的「鷓鴣粥」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「迷走神經性昏厥」這名稱令人感陌生，腦神經科醫生解說何謂迷走神經及其作用，再列舉此症的誘發因素。昏厥時或休息片刻就能緩和，但長遠而言可會對腦部造成破壞？大王、秀怡隨鄧達智來到商場內的溜冰場，主角卻是旁邊餐廳的多地融合美食！薄餅、手工意粉、日式咖喱都是其招牌菜，再加上嶄新的「喇沙韓式年糕」，「達智再埋單」此行大滿足。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐引領大家食「蠔」啲，「薑蔥蠔中蠔」集齊桶蠔、蠔豉，夠豪氣！

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 患乳癌風險與身材可有關係？陸浩明(六號)與隊友蔡嘉欣各持己見，期間更將某重量級前輩擺上枱！留意臨牀腫瘤科專科醫生講解患乳癌的風險因素，也教導女士自我檢查乳房的方法。問到全乳房切除手術可否百份百預防乳癌復發，張美妮、孫慧雪兩位靚媽，以及六號一方均獲讚講得有紋有路，且聽醫生詳析如何制定相關治療與預防方案。嘉賓藉遊戲帶出乳癌病人手術後的飲食注意事項；中醫師亦帶來「靈芝補氣湯」，並細談黑靈芝的抗癌作用。

programme.title: 陪著你走#8粵
programme.desc: 導生又領天從來到言重的單位，聽到<陪著你走和「愛是無所不能」廣告，回想三年前之事，更恍然與言重是鄰居。得知言重創作出「愛」廣告，天從大為感動。加勤勸加勁致電言重，加勁拒絕。天從向言重申訴不愛跑步……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想籌集三千日圓購買雜誌介紹的奇跡筆，碰巧雜誌懸紅徵求靈異照片，小丸子於是找小玉爸爸幫忙。小渚學芭蕾舞時扭傷腳，小丸子和小玉去家裡探望她，誰知小渚竟要求兩人請花輪同學來探望她。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈趕到零食廠，迎接前來爭奪健康零食祕笈的四位小兵。有小兵太「聽話」，兩次於「廠長話」熱身賽犯錯後，要搖頭提醒自己，以免再失手！正式淘汰賽，兩隊難分勝負，要待轉圈後有人鬆懈纔可分出高下。果園任務，有小兵未闖障礙物，已把目標水果摘下；也有小兵專心規避障礙物，卻似乎在果園內迷失，找不到水果？拼砌漢堡包遊戲，當薯片小兵花時間去找下一款食材時，曲奇小兵已默默砌好漢堡包了，及後更興奮得要圍圈跑慶祝勝利！

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 眾人不敵炎上達，回到神七結界暫避。為了修復七彩方塊，必須找到瑪蘿另一個弟弟須佐之男，誰知他便是麥格，然而失去記憶。為了阻止炎上彈完成，繼八百萬神後，鳳凰、玄武和白虎亦出外迎戰。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 傳統治療前列腺癌要做切除手術，但不少病人術後都會有尿失禁的問題，近年利用機械臂輔助手術，能夠大大改善這方面問題；益生菌有助消化和提升免疫力，選擇益生菌時需要留意甚麼？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某屋苑商場的自提點店舖，被指長期將貨品擺放於行人通道，更有長者遭貨品卡板絆倒受傷，店主對受傷長者表達歉意，並承諾盡量改善。圍村原居民祖屋遭私自賣掉一事，攝製隊相約起初提出裝修相連單位的鄰居會面，對方竟稱自己也是受害者？律師分析事主追回業權的可能性，並就鄰居可會涉及欺詐罪，發表看法。麥明詩出席活動，誕子近一年的她近況如何？疫情已過一段時間，如仍然維持定期檢測，對人對己有甚麼益處？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2722粵
programme.desc: 細曹總為宣傳餐廳，斥巨資聘請歌手演唱廣告歌，家聰遂推薦力王效勞。力王五音不全，幸得羣姐「相助」令歌藝突飛猛進。羣姐私下將與力王合唱的片段上載至社交平臺，獲得網民讚賞。細曹總決定聘用力王，羣姐更拉攏力王結成組合登臺表演。力王人氣急升，同時衍生其他問題，為了專心演戲，力王決意告別樂壇，羣姐卻為利益設法阻撓……另一方面，力王參加慈善節目，原定的短劇環節臨時改為與其他歌手合唱，他卻堅決拒絕獻唱……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#21粵PG
programme.desc: 何浩輝去民生貨櫃廠踩點，其後警方在聯合行動開始前，開會溝通行動細節。蘭崖軍團羣情激昂，三號車臨時機動組盯著蘭崖軍團的車，識別出巴朗派出的空車是障眼法。警方發現蘭崖軍團的兩輛車駛離新據點後，同時換了車。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#16粵普
programme.desc: 莊慎憶起當年兒子被栽贓謀反之事，想讓平城體驗痛失親兒的滋味，靜石繼續密謀逃離靜炎的監視，更用戲陽代為傳信，卻反被靜炎利用，隨歌召窮奇隊進宮，打算進宮保護平城，到達後發現平城失蹤，無人知道他的去向…

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 玲玲姐乘無人機登場，夠霸氣！眾姐姐為增儀式感，迅速換裝古代美人以享用宮廷宴美饌，還有表演看兼有禮物帶走？史萊姆是小孩愛玩的玩具，若希應熟悉，但若陪玩的不是兒女，而是一位靚仔，又會如何？玩得投入的卻是祖儀！健身室都是好介紹？若希、嘉欣看到有型帥教練示範及指導，並可按次預約心儀PT後，態度即變。姐姐們還找到地方大搞池邊派對，約來調酒師及猛男上門玩遊戲，祖儀更似乎樂於玩輸，好參與餵提子、被壁咚「懲罰」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 名媛望族#21粵PG
programme.desc: 小由往相睇，啟燊阻止更向她告白；啟燊把娶小由的決定告知卓萬，卓萬反對但被說服。心蘭對小由初感滿意，但知小由背景後即反對。子君向小由提出讓她做啟燊妾侍，小由答應。啟燊得悉一切，決定要對母親說清楚。

programme.title: 街坊廚神舌戰新臺韓粵
programme.desc: 主持相約田蕊妮喫遍韓牛的不同部位及內臟，牛香四溢！他們接着發掘韓國石鍋飯、港式石頭飯的滋味。金剛、小儀飽餐香港得獎名菜後，在「學廚PK賽」學煮冠軍級菜式「金勾銀柳」，能否盡得大廚真傳？

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#16粵PG
programme.desc: 有義行為變得異常，眾懷疑有義正結交女朋友，有朋發現對方竟是明星Icy。雜誌報道有義是為生意而出賣肉體的「保險鴨」。有朋看到有義與Icy進酒店，咬定有義不知廉恥，不知Icy與蔡公子正舉行驚世記者會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 令宜設計抓到殺王煜真兇，是區少夫人孃家的手下，十一娘帶二孃認清真相，二孃在大哥幫助下找區少夫人對質，將事情傳開；衛國公對開海禁一事態度放寬；徐太夫人希望十一娘能守護好徐家門庭，使她萌生退出仙綾閣之意。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德以河鮮美食聞名，更是華南主要的饅魚（白鱔）出口城市。鼎爺與阿譚來到順德府右市場，果然發現順德饅魚肥美鮮嫩的原因。鼎爺還發揮烹飪絕學，僅以簡單配料即可煮出甘香味美的「煎焗大白鱔」，並會講解處理白鱔的祕技。炮製香滑的「蛋白杏仁茶」，「推蛋白」手勢固然要正宗，鼎爺竟提到當年需要用上女士的絲襪！另一款「花膠陳皮紅棗南北杏糖水」採用多種上乘食材，喫得夠潤夠矜貴，要煮出最佳口感還要嚴守放入材料的先後次序。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 糖上癮是指對甜食產生強烈渴求，即使明知過量有害仍無法控制，每日建議攝取糖分是多少？過量攝取糖分會增加肥胖、糖尿病等風險，內分泌及糖尿科醫生詳析飲食上的「糖衣」陷阱，並教大家聰明減糖。新手媽媽較容易患上產後抑鬱，症狀包括長期情緒低落，甚至出現傷害自己的念頭，有哪些因素較大機會引致患病？精神科醫生提醒身邊人如何留意產婦有否出現異常，並帶來治療資訊。「睇餸食飯」，李文星師傅炮製一道「陳皮欖角煎龍躉球」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 長時間站立容易令人患上靜脈曲張，一雙絲襪就可預防？鄭衍峯與黃頌明及鄰組的蕭欣浩博士與朱智賢，分別就絲襪壓力、密度展開爭論。不妨聽專家講解普通絲襪與壓力襪的壓力值差異，再學做預防靜脈曲張小運動。另外，甚麼工作會增加患上腕管綜合症的風險？油漆含有揮發性有機物質，其中的芳香胺會增加膀胱癌風險。兩組分別挑選出髹油保護裝備，有人竟戴上「潛水裝備」？中醫師帶來有益關節的湯水；再看嘉賓大玩矇眼揀豆遊戲。

programme.title: 陪著你走#9粵
programme.desc: 天從在公園看劇時正恆突然出現，回家向天從打探，天從坦言明白正恆對自己只是放不下責任。天從獨自離家，言重因聽到一切不敢聲張，靜靜跟隨。言重回家，自願替天從照顧導生。言重送回導生，擔心天從有意外主動陪伴。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，濱治提議舉行試膽大會，並邀請小丸子參加，小丸子一口答應，但小玉卻因患感冒未能同行。小丸子在電視上看過《福爾摩斯》後，立志成為偵探，並且成功替爺爺解開明信片寄件人之謎。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 路牌除了指示方向外，也蘊藏着本土文化設計的歷史。本集「Kids’ Notes」請來研究路牌的愛好者，分享箇中樂趣。嘉賓介紹一種越來越少在香港路牌上出現的「監獄體」字體，其由來確與監獄相關。他建議小朋友如想尋找這些路牌，可到沙田區多加探索。辨認時，要留意哪些細節？嘉賓與其他愛好者合作，致力將監獄體轉化成電腦文字，但拍攝路牌作參考資料時卻遇上不少困難。他更珍藏了一個舊式安全島燈箱，為房間帶來街道感覺。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 傳送門關閉，阿渡等人無法回到原來世界，須佐之男告訴他們還有一個方法，便是挑戰「不全部猜對就回不7」。眾人最終成功通關，回到原來世界後，除了巨大的炎上彈外，還發現所有人都在為自己打氣。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 週年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 西沙有新盤交樓，驗樓師發現，附送衣櫃沒固定好，牆身也有瑕疵，質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2723粵
programme.desc: 樹仁於玩遊戲時遇到態度惡劣的職員，對方不肯給予他應得的禮物。樹仁忍無可忍，遂表現兇惡，終令對方屈服，還得到額外獎品。原來樹仁眼部不適，遊戲過程中不慎觸動痛處而「單起眼」，因此面目更顯猙獰，令職員心生畏懼。樹仁發現「扮惡」可解決不少問題，遂樂此不疲，成功以惡制惡，替不少人「出頭」。然而，他似乎走火入魔，對家人亦惡形惡相，因而人見人怕。凌凌唯有設法提醒樹仁，希望他能「棄惡從善」……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#22粵PG
programme.desc: 前來拿貨的周雄把錢交給巴朗，同時認出了謝庭威是員警，蘭崖軍團和周雄雙方開始槍戰。警方循著槍聲沖進交易現場，希瓦為謝庭威擋槍。巴朗告訴周雄這是誤會，周雄讓巴朗自己處理家務事，把軍火搬上廂式貨車。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 平城罵隨歌沒稱帝野心，說出清鈺死亡真相刺激隨歌，父子劍拔弩張，一笑斥平城枉為人父。莊慎被追問下說出景珩是平城所殺，莊後不可置信；慕容仲得知慕容曜與莊慎謀反，打算負荊請罪；一笑擔心隨歌，原來隨歌就在門外

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 節目回到上海，凱恩與沛珈置身隱世居酒屋，獲帥哥老闆推介試喫橫隔膜、掌心的雞串燒，令她們也大膽起來！特別矜貴的燒提燈，口感有多「得意」？燒肉最怕麻煩，找爆肌店員幫你燒，賣點是乾式熟成肉，厚實又多汁。凱恩隨依婷到衝浪館學習基本動作，為的是可穿著西裝兼牽手「人氣」外籍教練一起室內衝浪，姐姐立即變得型格！玲玲率眾來到坐擁外灘景緻的餐廳，享用專人拆肉的大閘蟹，以及考刀功的松鼠桂魚，不時不食，味蕾大滿足！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#22粵
programme.desc: 卓萬宣佈啟燊與小由婚事，子君要把喜訊通知爾嫣並接她回家。達志拒收小由禮物，更指不會出席婚禮。啟燁開會，廷亨來到，表示日輝經營海砂生意，或可與他合作。日輝舉行慶祝會，啟燁斥爾熹反骨，卓萬與爾嫣因此大吵。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#16粵PG
programme.desc: 有義行為變得異常，眾懷疑有義正結交女朋友，有朋發現對方竟是明星Icy。雜誌報道有義是為生意而出賣肉體的「保險鴨」。有朋看到有義與Icy進酒店，咬定有義不知廉恥，不知Icy與蔡公子正舉行驚世記者會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 令宜設計抓到殺王煜真兇，是區少夫人孃家的手下，十一娘帶二孃認清真相，二孃在大哥幫助下找區少夫人對質，將事情傳開；衛國公對開海禁一事態度放寬；徐太夫人希望十一娘能守護好徐家門庭，使她萌生退出仙綾閣之意。

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵
programme.desc: 阿姐預備好中式聖誕大餐，款待錢嘉樂、黃智雯、蝦頭、胡渭康與家族成員。嘉樂胡謅拆禮物日日子及聖誕紀念屈原都中招？智雯不停舉報同時不停被夾裝飾，六號「應記一功」！嘉樂玩「狼人」期間不停說「夢話」，到底他來自哪個陣營？劊子手投票意願與最終決定有所不同，造就難得的一次打和局面。嘉樂自稱曾拍戲雙腳裂骨，但晚上仍然到的士高跳舞，怎樣可做到？蝦頭描述在泰國為愛被追殺的經歷，阿姐卻只好奇她如何認識對方及分手原因！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#17粵
programme.desc: 溢滿感到孤獨，高慶令他明白友情的重要，更留下小龜陪伴他。網上出現電腦病毒，溢滿「搶救」家人的電腦，可惜遲來一步，令有義「中毒死機」。有義即遷怒溢滿令他與網友失去聯絡，但溢滿卻成為萬眾矚目的巨星。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#28粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘獲準續留仙綾閣，對令宜感激不已。羅大太太病危，同時楊姨娘也因病離世，二孃悲憤，重提十一娘當初逃婚之事，使令宜心生芥蒂。十一娘對令宜敞開心扉，二人終解開心結。丹陽故意派小蝶服侍曉蘭，激化二人矛盾。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德是漁米之鄉，河鮮尤其聞名。鼎爺偕同阿譚品嚐「無骨魚」，一魚三喫滋味非常。為了滿足拍檔「食過返尋味」的要求，鼎爺特意炮製「順德家鄉燜魽魚」。魽魚魚肉嫩滑，選購時有何須知？鼎爺把魽魚油炸之後，再於魚背淋上滾油，又是甚麼原因？鼎爺分享買南瓜心得，新疆與日本出產的品種分別有何特點？烹調「豉蒜南瓜燜豬肋條」期間，鼎爺刻意保留南瓜皮，提升菜式的甘香味。他還提醒觀眾注意南瓜的下鍋時間，避免豆豉掩蓋瓜香。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 兒科病症五花八門，今集請來兒科醫生為大家進修有關知識。小朋友的牙齒意外脫落應如何保存？「仁醫」郭子豪及海俊傑的專業解釋連醫生都讚不絕口。若沒有輔助工具保存牙齒，如何是好？另外，接受母乳餵哺的嬰兒一星期排便一次屬正常嗎？亦聽醫生講解哪種水不宜用來沖泡奶粉。小朋友發高燒應助其降溫還是焗汗？賴慰玲與張振朗一組現分歧！醫生主張哪些相對溫和的處理方法？營養師亦會介紹一款有益腦部發展、增免疫力的米紙卷小食。

programme.title: 陪著你走#10粵
programme.desc: 天從向正恆提出分手；言重播放「愛是無所不能1」的影帶卻卡在機內。他外出修理時遇見天從，邀她同行。兩人到洪民浩的見面會，現場播放韓劇，言重為天從講解劇情。兩人來到加勁的麵檔，天從更令言重知道加勁心意……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐有新的連身裙穿，小丸子大呼不公平，後來更趁姐姐不在時拿來偷穿，結果兩姊妹吵起上來。小丸子去做收音機體操，期間認識到一名自稱忍者後裔的老婦，聽她說完之後，小丸子對忍者產生濃厚興趣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 簡單一個拋球動作，都可以練習手眼協調。這集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」的參與者以二人為一組，聽從兒童體適能教練指示，從頭頂、胸前、下方把球拋給拍檔。及後難度升級，拋接時要單腳站立，大家又做得到嗎？第二節的「核心穩定訓練」，有助改善坐姿。在瑜伽墊上做好基本姿勢，完成「捲腹」、「俄羅斯轉體」、「側平板支撐」等動作，還要記得換邊做，平衡地鍛練左右肌肉。另帶來AI生成動畫《生命之水》下半部份。

programme.title: 祕密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵已有十天沒在偶像公主空間出現。自從看過Ruby=Lazuli的演唱會，陽葵便完全失去自信。就在這時，陽葵好像聽到娃娃麥麥在呼喚自己。順著這把聲音，陽葵進入了夢境世界，她在這裡發現，自己甚至忘了如何展露笑容。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 書中自有黃金屋，不少閱讀愛好者，都喜歡到樓上書店尋寶。經常有批評指香港閱讀風氣不盛行，這些二樓書店有何出路？港人又喜歡看甚麼書呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫1999年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2724粵
programme.desc: 城安在直播中銷售吳旺達的化妝品，起初生意低迷。意外的是，瑞素於自己的頻道直播期間，向網民讚賞城安的產品，令銷量大幅上升。城安見有利可圖，遂與瑞素合作推銷，卻在人氣方面被瑞素比下去，他的帶貨事業更因此陷入危機。雖然城安嘗試自救，但毫無成效。其後，城安偶然發現可為網站「谷流量」之法，於是刻意製造話題以「蹭熱度」，還為此不惜採取非常手段……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#23粵PG
programme.desc: 陳耀揚率眾人到公司找到李總，將他帶回警署審問。李總交代，路易士實為幕後老闆，支援鐘斯開發智富APP，安娜在智富一直都有眼線，路易士告訴李總，只要收購了財通，智富就能成為全香港使用者最多的股票交易軟體。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#18粵普PG
programme.desc: 戲陽為討好靜石，放下公主尊嚴，但靜石仍不為所動，戲陽終於崩潰。靜炎告訴戲陽她父皇病倒了，並說靜石早已知曉，有意挑撥她與靜石的關係。慕容仲到宮中負荊請罪，他自稱為求死而來，鳳平城卻一語道破他是求生。

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 想培養貴族氣質，姐姐們學打馬球，再往擺滿古董珍藏的法式烘焙咖啡店，優雅地享用法式批點。猛男私廚上門煮菜，足不出戶即可嚐到川味「住家飯」，色香味俱全！更多美食情報，沛珈跟曉昆一探主打「禿黃油麵」、「六蝦麵」的麵館，蟹、蝦精華接連衝擊味蕾。凱恩前往復古風咖啡店，探問新疆老闆如何適應城市節奏，還趁機獨享慢活時光。人氣音樂酒吧以專業舞臺設備，打造演唱會級氣氛。眾姐姐投入上海夜生活，有人向小鮮肉主動出擊？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 名媛望族#23粵
programme.desc: 爾嫣追問爾熹，透露卓萬誤會她與日輝關係。懿芳的婦女會朋友表示力行撞車死了；卓萬派學祈及以誠出席力行喪禮，百鏘認為兒子被浩頤拒絕後失事而亡，要卓萬負責。廷亨與百鏘與子君對著幹，指反蓄婢令婢女變得無依靠。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 兒科病症五花八門，今集請來兒科醫生為大家進修有關知識。小朋友的牙齒意外脫落應如何保存？「仁醫」郭子豪及海俊傑的專業解釋連醫生都讚不絕口。若沒有輔助工具保存牙齒，如何是好？另外，接受母乳餵哺的嬰兒一星期排便一次屬正常嗎？亦聽醫生講解哪種水不宜用來沖泡奶粉。小朋友發高燒應助其降溫還是焗汗？賴慰玲與張振朗一組現分歧！醫生主張哪些相對溫和的處理方法？營養師亦會介紹一款有益腦部發展、增免疫力的米紙卷小食。

programme.title: 陪著你走#10粵
programme.desc: 天從向正恆提出分手；言重播放「愛是無所不能1」的影帶卻卡在機內。他外出修理時遇見天從，邀她同行。兩人到洪民浩的見面會，現場播放韓劇，言重為天從講解劇情。兩人來到加勁的麵檔，天從更令言重知道加勁心意……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#17粵
programme.desc: 溢滿感到孤獨，高慶令他明白友情的重要，更留下小龜陪伴他。網上出現電腦病毒，溢滿「搶救」家人的電腦，可惜遲來一步，令有義「中毒死機」。有義即遷怒溢滿令他與網友失去聯絡，但溢滿卻成為萬眾矚目的巨星。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#28粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘獲準續留仙綾閣，對令宜感激不已。羅大太太病危，同時楊姨娘也因病離世，二孃悲憤，重提十一娘當初逃婚之事，使令宜心生芥蒂。十一娘對令宜敞開心扉，二人終解開心結。丹陽故意派小蝶服侍曉蘭，激化二人矛盾。

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: 單立文陪同胡蓓蔚、胡定欣約見閨密Jade，力騷「胡說八道會」實力，分享出演艷情片的趣事；Jade以焗羊架配芝士焗薯、煙三文魚沙律、法式焦糖燉蛋招待三位。定欣的現任男友由豹哥介紹，但原來她曾對豹哥動心？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全臺首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超羣，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真兇！！】最強正義檢察官樸政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真兇，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 歡唱小浣熊

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師(完)
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全臺首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超羣，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真兇！！】最強正義檢察官樸政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真兇，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.desc: Pete is cautiously excited about reuniting with his college crew for a birthday weekend. But, one by one, his friends slowly turn against him. Is he being punished, is he paranoid, or is he part of some sick joke?

programme.title: Road To Your Heart
programme.desc: In this sweet road-trip movie, Basson, a young businessman journeys to Cape Town for his father’s funeral and to fulfill certain tasks in the will. He meets bohemian Amory along the way and they encounter hilarious moments, disappointments and heartaches.

programme.title: My Killer Buddy
programme.desc: Denni is 10 years old and has a mission, to save his mother from his father’s violence. For this reason he devises an infallible plan: he will have him killed by someone who kills people for a living, a super-killer.

programme.title: Cloves & Carnations
programme.desc: In snowy and desolate South Eastern Anatolian, Musa carries the corpse of his deceased wife to their homeland with his granddaughter. As they get closer to a country at war, their run-in with the police separates them in different directions.

programme.title: From The Vine
programme.desc: A burnt-out executive experiences an ethical crisis and travels back to his hometown in rural Italy to recalibrate his moral compass.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows A Vigilante Justice
programme.desc: When a ransom demand suddenly appears, the disappearance of 19-year-old Tim Jatzkowski is now a cause of concern. While the boy’s father wants the police to rescue him, inspector Martin Brühl tries to convince his family to pay the ransom.

programme.title: Victim
programme.desc: Ukrainian immigrant Irina lives with her son Igor in a small Czech border town. When she discovers that Igor has been assaulted by three Romas her whole world comes crashing down. As times goes on, Irina begins to spot inconsistencies in his story.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: Soane, a young Caledonian, leaves home to try his luck in France as a rugby player. Left on his own in a foreign land, Soane’s odyssey will take him on the path to becoming a man in a world where there is a price to be paid for success.

programme.title: NR24
programme.desc: The most ordinary man became the perfect spy. 22-year-old Gunnar Sønsteby decides to resist Nazi-Germany on the day of the invasion to later lead the "Oslo-gang" in executing countless daring acts of sabotage making him Norway's greatest war hero.

programme.title: Staring Into The Abyss
programme.desc: LKA officer David Wallat monitors released child murderer Joseph Maria Hagenow, now housed by a village pastor. As Hagenow manipulates his guards, a child’s disappearance threatens to unravel Wallat’s entire operation.

programme.title: Irreplaceable
programme.desc: Jean-Pierre Werner, a revered and devoted country doctor, discovers that he is suffering from an inoperable tumor. As a doctor from the city arrives to help him with his practice, Werner is troubled by the thought that he is no longer irreplaceable.

programme.desc: Actor Sterling K. Brown joins Bear in the high mountains of Colorado, where they battle plummeting temperatures while descending a sheer rock face, track an elusive deer and rappel down a waterfall.

programme.title: Griff's Canadian Adventure (S1) - Happiness
programme.desc: Griff Rhys Jones finishes his journey across Canada in the popular, lifestyle province of British Columbia in the Pacific Northwest and discovers what it is about this place that makes people so happy.

programme.title: World's Most Amazing Walks with Robson Green (S1) - Hadrian's Wall
programme.desc: Robson Green sets out on one of the most iconic walks in the UK, the Hadrian's Wall path. For Robson, who was born and raised in the North East, it's a deeply personal and emotional journey.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls (S4) - Roger Federer
programme.desc: Bear and tennis champion Roger Federer hit the slopes the hard way.

programme.title: Deadly 60 (S6) - Ocean Oddballs
programme.desc: Steve is underwater in Indonesia with funny-looking frogfish, a stargazer, flamboyant cuttlefish, a mimic octopus and a Bobbit worm.

programme.title: Deadly 60 (S6) - Bat Spectacular
programme.desc: Steve Backshall is in Zambia to witness ten million fruit bats undertake the world's largest aerial migration. However, these bats are a buffet for Africa's top three eagles.

programme.title: One Cup: A Thousand Stories (S1) - The Art Of Tea
programme.desc: Tea ceremonies of the past inform present day rituals - including a breath-taking outdoor tea ceremony for 100 people on the banks of a river in Taiwan. The skills and passion of the world famous Rock Tea producers are celebrated in a blind-tasting competition.

programme.title: The World's Deadliest Weather (S6) - EP5
programme.desc: Record-breaking Hurricane Otis devastates holiday hotspot Acapulco on Mexico's coast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Sleepybyes
programme.desc: The Teletubbies say goodnight to the Tiddlytubbies; it is sleepybyes time. But Po isn't tired anymore and goes for a special ride on her scooter.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - Q
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'q', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see question marks, a quilt and a queen, and even meet a quail quacking quietly!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Bubble Trouble
programme.desc: Bubbles, bubbles, all over OKIDO! Zam invents a super-strong bubble machine, but things go a bit wrong and Zim finds himself in a spot of bother.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pirate Parade
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him! Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: Can the Go Jetters save the world's stinkiest plant from becoming Glitch's latest perfume?

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Seesaw
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help move him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Elephant
programme.desc: On Jen's birthday she and Andy are sent to follow a new baby elephant to make sure it can use it's trunk properly.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S2) - Mission: Carrots
programme.desc: It's puppy cadet training day, when pups all over Woofton see if they've got what it takes to become an assistance dog.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild (S1) - Tree Kangaroo and Seahorse
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet the tree kangaroo and learn how it's great at climbing. They then take a look at the seahorses, and it's feeding time.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Cup
programme.desc: Bella plays with her favourite cup - it makes the perfect drum for a sing along with Lift. Together, they visit Kingsley and Queenie who play the 'Tea Party Dash', but who will win?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Puzzle Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Training Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Bridge Badge
programme.desc: It's bridge building time... the squirrels help a quarreling group of Gerbils.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Brandenburg Gate, Germany
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch takes the quadriga from the Brandenburg Gate, the Go Jetters must stop him before he reaches Grim HQ.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Statue of Liberty, USA
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch makes the Statue of Liberty fall right into the path of a passing ferry.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - The Inventor's Spectacular Bridge
programme.desc: When the Rickety Old Bridge collapses, trapping Toby and Henrietta on the other side of the ravine, inventor Ruth is asked to build a new one.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Scooter Stand Still
programme.desc: Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah & Duck help him to get it back.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Wool on Wheels
programme.desc: Scarf Lady is holding a 'knitted treats' sale in the park, but the weather is causing a problem...

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Farm
programme.desc: Amare asks Stanley to help her on the farm. Stanley asks Little Woo, Fred and Fifi to join him in sowing seeds, watering plants and picking apples, all whilst having fun.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Shop
programme.desc: Stanley covers Jose at the shop and ends up making too much popcorn. So as not to waste it all, Stanley and his friends put on a film night to screen Little Woo's film.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - My Family
programme.desc: Monty is teased by a school friend for having a strange family and begins to wish the Kazoops were more like everyone else.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to go Swimming
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran go swimming in a lido on a hot summer day. JoJo is excited to show Gran Gran what she has learnt in her recent swimming lessons.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Ambition Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Great Barrier Reef, Australia
programme.desc: The team dives into action as Glitch's treasure hunt endangers the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Celery

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Dragon Boat Beats
programme.desc: The Supermarket is frozen over and Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Tomato practice for the boat race by using chopsticks for oars, but it doesn't go well as they're out of sync with each other.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - How to be a Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids a Supertato training film, but Evil Pea sneaks in to take over Tato Tower. The Grape Kids use the rug launcher to eject Evil Pea out of the tower.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Up Down, Down Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Uppy Downy. They have fun going up down, down up!

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - R
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'r', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We roar, dance like a robot and see a rainbow!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Dot Pursuit

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Waiting Badge

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Shopping Badge

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous "Twin Swords" in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: One of the great Kung-fu film characters is "Beggar Su", a legendary Ching Dynasty figure who was also a member of the famous Ten Kwangtung Tigers. Little-known director Liu Shih-yu uses the best Kung-fu actors Shaw Studios had to offer to tell a rare, colorful, action-packed adventure, as Beggar Su and his brother train incessantly to defeat the brutally powerful thief called Centipede.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Sai Shang Feng Yun Ji - EP26
programme.desc: Stay tuned to CCTV-4 as we introduce you to the various content and programming on the channel.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.desc: Jess and the puppies find some strange green hairy stuff growing under the water barrel. The puppies are scared of it and Jess promises them that he'll find out what it is at once. Hey, that's the big question! Jess thinks the green hairy stuff might be grass. He goes to ask Baa, who's a grass expert. Baa, Billie and Jess compare the green hairy stuff and ordinary grass using Billie's magnifying glass. It isn't grass but it is a plant.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Find My Friends?
programme.desc: Jess's friends have planned a special surprise but he can't find any of them to find out what it is! How can he find his friends? Hey, that's the Big Question! He finds a trail of Willow's hoof prints but they stop at a puddle. Then they follow a trail of wool from Baa but that stops too. They find a walking haystack but it turns out to be Mimi. Jess is baffled.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are Acorns Buried Under The Tree?
programme.desc: Jess and the puppies find a pile of acorns buried under a tree. The puppies want to play with them, but Jess thinks they should find out why the acorns are buried there first. That's the Big Question! Baa and Billie don't know - Billie says she'd eat acorns rather than bury them! Jess goes off to see Mimi who's planting her conker to grow a chestnut tree. Jess wonders if someone planted the acorns to grown into an oak but Mimi doesn't think so.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Sound Like Brown Bird?
programme.desc: Brown Bird sings a lovely song before leaving for winter migration. Jess would love to sound like Brown Bird - then they could listen to her song all year round. But how can he sound like her? That's the Big Question. Billie and Baa suggest Jess sings but his singing voice doesn't sound like Brown Bird at all. Mimi tries to mimic Brown Bird by whistling but that's not the right sound either. Maybe if Jess makes a hooty sound by blowing through his paws? That's still not the right sound.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Do We Make A Boat?

Some things are too heavy, some are too light… having tried lots of options and worked out that they need something light and boat shaped, they make Mimi's paper hats into boats for their boat race. Perfect!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abysmal Altercation of the Abominable Altitooth
programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Bout of the Beastly Barfilisk
programme.desc: Harold and George don't ask for much -- just a fun scavenger hunt that doesn't include doing Krupp's errands. Careful what you wish for, fellas.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP2
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP11
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP2
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP8
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP11
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: 直播·市場零距離 | 解碼科創綜指 —— 聚焦科創板未來發展建設
programme.desc: 當新質生產力成爲時代關鍵詞，“十五五” 規劃建議爲科技創新錨定方向，科創板正迎來政策、產業、資金深度共振的黃金髮展期！而科創綜指，作爲覆蓋科創板核心資產的全景縮影，既是硬科技賽道的 “晴雨表”，更是投資者洞察行業趨勢的核心窗口。2026年，科創板改革持續深化，硬科技賽道風雲變幻，科創綜指將如何勾勒行業發展脈絡？又將爲市場帶來哪些新機遇？\r\n1月5日14:00，《市場零距離》特別節目重磅來襲！我們特邀四大業界權威大咖，爲您解鎖科創板發展與投資的核心邏輯。

programme.title: 直播｜突發！美國轟炸委內瑞拉
programme.desc: 當地時間2026年1月3日凌晨，美軍對委內瑞拉首都加拉加斯發動空襲，多架直升機低空突襲軍事設施並引發爆炸，總統馬杜羅宣佈全國進入緊急狀態。美國總統特朗普稱已抓獲委總統馬杜羅及其夫人並帶離委內瑞拉。局勢將如何發展，第一財經邀請各方專家進行解讀！

programme.title: 首席策略薈 | 預見 “十五五”：解碼政策新座標 搶佔投資新藍海
programme.desc: 《首席策略薈》2025年年終線下沙龍 12月31日下午將重磅上線網絡直播！這場深度交流盛宴，將通過主題演講+圓桌對話的形式，帶您全方位把握 “十五五” 規劃下的投資新機。\r\n宏觀層面，復旦大學教授韋宗友解讀國際環境與大國關係趨勢，九方智投首席經濟學家肖立晟展望中國經濟走向，拆解雙循環戰略轉型邏輯；策略維度，摩根資產管理、浙商證券、九方金融研究所專家共探 2026 春季行情佈局，解鎖 “十五五” 黃金賽道挖掘路徑；行業聚焦，電力設備與新能源、計算機AI兩大熱門領域首席分析師，深度剖析行業觸底反彈機遇與投資邏輯躍遷方向。\r\n權威嘉賓陣容、多維度乾貨輸出，從政策解碼到賽道篩選，從宏觀趨勢到行業細節，助您精準把握政策導向與市場風口，快來鎖定直播，搶佔投資新藍海！

programme.title: 2025年終直播丨十大關鍵詞，讀懂經濟裏的人間煙火
programme.desc: 2025年的最後一天，第一財經陪你一起度過。即將過去的2025年，生活彷彿被按下了加速鍵，信息爆炸，似乎所有行業都在發生着鉅變。關稅、股市、黃金價格都成爲每日上下翻飛、隨時要衝破記錄的數字，攪動着國際貿易與大國關係，也攪動着我們每個人的日常生活。大模型、機器人、商業航天，硬科技的迅猛發展帶飛了全球資本的流向，令人應接不暇的同時也讓我們思考如何能跟上這樣的節奏。而當新能源車、外賣等行業的競爭進入白熱化、幾十億的資金一天內就能燒完時候，我們一邊更加謹慎的用訂單投票，一邊開始反思如此“內卷”何時有盡頭。所以現在，讓我們一起把時間往回撥，細數2025年，在世界極速變動的當下，我們如何在宏大的敘事中探知未來的模樣，如何在微小的快樂中感受生活的溫度。\r\n我們選取了十個關鍵詞，邀請多位業內重磅嘉賓，一起聊一聊關於2025年的記憶，一起來讀懂經濟裏的人間煙火。

programme.title: 直播丨2026年大展望——宏觀經濟與大類資產策略會
programme.desc: 告別2025年，我們將迎來2026年。\r\n新的一年，美聯儲降息節奏如何？國內貨幣政策是否會進一步寬鬆？宏觀經濟的溫和復甦能否延續？A股和港股是否會再上一個臺階?\r\n寧波銀行與您一起前瞻佈局市場，共啓投資新篇!

programme.desc: 爲進一步推動碳管理體系建設與合作、搭建行業交流平臺、凝聚碳管理領域共識、推動重點行業低碳轉型實踐落地、探討可持續發展與碳管理協同路徑、打造地方低碳經濟發展地標。2025年EATNS碳管理體系大會暨碳中和行動聯盟可持續發展研討會將於2025年12月22日13:30在合肥舉辦，本次大會由上海環交所、EATNS碳管理體系評定工作委員會、碳中和行動聯盟主辦。邀請政府領導、行業專家及在“雙碳”領域取得相應成果的企業高管等建言獻策。

programme.title: 直播丨海南自貿港正式封關 如何翻開我國制度型開放新篇章？
programme.desc: 2025年12月18日，海南自由貿易港封關將正式啓動，實施以“‘一線’放開、‘二線’管住、島內自由”爲基本特徵的自由化便利化政策制度。海南自貿港封關後如何運作？企業會享受到什麼紅利?《財經夜行線》邀請商務部國際貿易經濟合作研究院研究員周密一起來解析封關背後的制度創新與市場機遇。

programme.title: 直播丨大資管時代的長線增值與生態協同
programme.desc: 當下，中國資管行業處於轉型升級的關鍵階段，打破剛兌、淨值化轉型成爲行業共識，而低利率環境的持續與全球市場的波動，更讓“長線增值”與“生態協同”成爲行業發展的核心關鍵詞。\r\n基於此，第一財經邀請保險、公募基金、券商三大核心機構，從不同視角解讀行業趨勢、共探發展路徑。敬請關注。

programme.title: 直播丨2025第一財經資本年會
programme.desc: 2025年，是中國“十四五”規劃收官與“十五五”規劃謀劃的歷史交匯點。產業鏈、創新鏈、資本鏈的深度融合，已成爲支撐產業升級、培育新質生產力的關鍵路徑。第一財經資本年會以“新里程、新動能”爲主題，聚焦新五年週期下的創新路徑與產業躍遷，深入探討資本市場如何更高效服務實體經濟、創新要素如何優化配置，以及如何構建開放協同的產業創新生態系統。

programme.title: 直播丨不是“封島”！海南封關對個人、產業及開放格局究竟有何影響？
programme.desc: 2025年12月18日，海南自由貿易港正式啓動全島封關運作。從藍圖繪就到落地生根，歷經多年籌備，成爲中國第一個全面實施封關政策的自由貿易港。這一重大舉措，也標誌着中國對外開放進入全新階段。海南全島封關首日，第一財經派出記者進行實地探訪，並邀請專家學者和觀察員共同進行政策解讀，深入探討海南自貿港封關運作對於普通人生活、海南產業發展以及中國開放格局究竟有何影響。

programme.title: 直播丨《自貿港·財經視界》啓播儀式
programme.desc: 由海南廣播電視總檯與上海廣播電視臺第一財經聯合打造的權威財經欄目《自貿港·財經視界》啓播儀式即將舉行。來自海南省委省政府相關部門、金融機構、研究機構、重點園區、企業和媒體代表等近百位嘉賓，共同見證欄目啓播，並就封關後海南的發展機遇與制度構建展開深度研討。

programme.title: 直播丨“匯見新機，策馬新程” 匯正財經2026 資本市場策略會
programme.desc: 2025年全球經濟承壓，國內經濟在政策精準發力下彰顯韌性，新質生產力加速崛起，科創板改革深化，新能源、低空經濟等賽道釋放萬億級發展空間。恰逢“十五五” 開局之際，匯正財經“匯見新機，策馬新程”2026 資本市場策略會將於12月14日舉辦。業內專家齊聚，解析宏觀政策、拆解賽道價值、解讀政策紅利，誠邀您共探“十五五”時期的投資邏輯與財富圖景。

programme.title: 價值與投資丨蛻變破局 文娛行業新敘事
programme.desc: 講好滬市企業的價值邏輯，直面市場關心的投資話題，聚焦高質量發展，共建價值迴歸的市場生態，由上海證券交易所和第一財經發起的“價值與投資”系列投關節目，2025年全新升級。第八期節目邀請東方明珠董祕、上海電影董祕、中金公司研究部執行總經理，共同探討文娛行業的蛻變破局。

programme.title: 數新風 | 當機器人走進 “人間煙火” 萬億機會如何佈局？—— 直擊 2025 全球開發者先鋒大會暨國際具身智能技能大賽
programme.desc: 12月12日，爲期3天的2025全球開發者先鋒大會暨國際具身智能技能大賽在上海張江正式啓幕！這裏的機器人不光能在廢墟中逆行救援、車間裏微米級裝配，還會疊帶污漬的衣服、插錯落有致的鮮花，把“實驗室黑科技”活成了觸手可及的“人間煙火氣”。這場全球頂尖技能比拼，既是技術實力的擂臺，更是資本嗅覺的風向標 —— 既折射出 “十五五”規劃建議中“推動具身智能成爲新經濟增長點” 的政策東風，更藏着2035年突破萬億元的市場藍海。當機器人走進廚房、工廠、醫院，這條 “技術 + 資本” 雙驅動的賽道，到底有哪些普通人也能關注的投資機會？12月12日14:00《數新風》，帶您直擊張江賽場一線：看機器人 “會幹活” 的硬核實力，拆萬億賽道 “能賺錢” 的佈局密碼，一起解鎖科技與生活碰撞的財富新風向！

programme.title: 一線論壇丨2025 AI+產業應用創新大會
